answer: Deposits are visible in river, and crystal reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 131 aliases, and each one needs its own funded bridge account. That bill is paid per identity, so 394 aliases cost 67 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
